description: Annotation depth, taxonomic span and antibody-based localisation of UMAD1 versus the confirmed ESCRT-I subunits
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. UniProt entry status / protein existence for the UMA-domain family
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
ACC = {"UMAD1":"C9J7I0","MVB12A":"Q96EY5","MVB12B":"Q9H7P6","UBAP1":"Q9NZ09",
       "VPS37A":"Q8NEZ2","VPS37B":"Q9H9H4","VPS37C":"A5D8V6","VPS37D":"Q86XT2",
       "TSG101":"Q99816","VPS28":"Q9UK41"}
up = {}
for g,a in ACC.items():
    j = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()
    gos = [x for x in j.get("uniProtKBCrossReferences",[]) if x["database"]=="GO"]
    up[g] = dict(reviewed = j["entryType"],
                 pe       = j.get("proteinExistence"),
                 length   = j["sequence"]["length"],
                 n_go     = len(gos),
                 n_pubs   = len(j.get("references",[])))
print(f"{'gene':8s} {'entry':28s} {'existence':28s} {'len':>4s} {'GO':>4s} {'refs':>5s}")
for g,v in up.items():
    print(f"{g:8s} {v['reviewed']:28s} {str(v['pe']):28s} {v['length']:4d} {v['n_go']:4d} {v['n_pubs']:5d}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Taxonomic span of each gene name in UniProtKB (entry counts)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
clades = {"Vertebrata":7742,"Arthropoda":6656,"Nematoda":6231,"Fungi":4751,"Viridiplantae":33090}
def n_entries(gene, taxid):
    r = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
                     params={"query":f'(gene_exact:{gene}) AND (taxonomy_id:{taxid})',
                             "size":0,"format":"json"},timeout=90)
    return int(r.headers.get("x-total-results",0))
tax_genes = ["UMAD1","MVB12A","MVB12B","UBAP1","VPS37A","TSG101","VPS28"]
TAX = {g:{c:n_entries(g,t) for c,t in clades.items()} for g in tax_genes}
print("\nUniProtKB entries per gene name per clade")
print(f"{'clade':14s}" + "".join(f"{g:>9s}" for g in tax_genes))
for c in clades:
    print(f"{c:14s}" + "".join(f"{TAX[g][c]:9d}" for g in tax_genes))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Human Protein Atlas IF subcellular location (antibody-based)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
hpa_genes = ["UMAD1","MVB12A","MVB12B","UBAP1","VPS37A","VPS37B","VPS37C","VPS37D","TSG101","VPS28"]
LOC = {}
for g in hpa_genes:
    js = requests.get("https://www.proteinatlas.org/api/search_download.php",
                      params={"search":g,"format":"json",
                              "columns":"g,scl,rnatsm","compress":"no"},timeout=120).json()
    hit=[x for x in js if x.get("Gene")==g]
    LOC[g]= hit[0].get("Subcellular location") or [] if hit else []
print("\nHPA antibody-based subcellular location")
for g in hpa_genes:
    ves = "VESICLES" if any("Vesicle" in l for l in LOC[g]) else "-"
    print(f"{g:8s} {ves:9s} {LOC[g]}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# figure
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
fig,axes = plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.6))

ax=axes[0]
cl=list(clades); x=np.arange(len(cl)); w=0.12
for i,g in enumerate(tax_genes):
    vals=[TAX[g][c] for c in cl]
    ax.bar(x+(i-3)*w, vals, w, label=g,
           color="crimson" if g=="UMAD1" else plt.cm.Blues(0.3+0.1*i))
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(cl,rotation=25,ha="right")
ax.set_yscale("symlog"); ax.set_ylabel("UniProtKB entries with this gene name")
ax.set_title("A  Taxonomic span of ESCRT-I gene names")
ax.legend(fontsize=7,ncol=2)

ax=axes[1]
ves=[1 if any("Vesicle" in l for l in LOC[g]) else 0 for g in hpa_genes]
nuc=[1 if any(l in ("Nucleoplasm","Nucleoli","Nuclear bodies") for l in LOC[g]) else 0 for g in hpa_genes]
y=np.arange(len(hpa_genes))
ax.barh(y-0.2,ves,0.4,color="#2b7a4b",label="vesicles")
ax.barh(y+0.2,nuc,0.4,color="#8c4bb0",label="nucleoplasm/nucleoli")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(hpa_genes,fontsize=9)
for t in ax.get_yticklabels():
    if t.get_text()=="UMAD1": t.set_color("crimson"); t.set_fontweight("bold")
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["absent","reported"])
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("B  HPA antibody localisation")

ax=axes[2]
gs=list(ACC); go=[up[g]["n_go"] for g in gs]; rf=[up[g]["n_pubs"] for g in gs]
y=np.arange(len(gs))
ax.barh(y-0.2,go,0.4,color="#d08a2e",label="GO annotations")
ax.barh(y+0.2,rf,0.4,color="#4878a8",label="UniProt references")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(gs,fontsize=9)
for t in ax.get_yticklabels():
    if t.get_text()=="UMAD1": t.set_color("crimson"); t.set_fontweight("bold")
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xscale("symlog"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("C  Annotation depth in UniProtKB")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
